messages:
Ravi: Quick sync: noticed the modal action row in the metrics export modal gets visually cramped when a toast appears anchored to the bottom. thinking we should standardize on either vertical stacking at small widths or a persistent gap token + z-index rule. thoughts? https://figma.redwood/metrics/export-modal :eyes:
Marta: vertical stack on <520px is fine. also propose increasing the action gap token from 8 -> 12 for compact flows. keeps buttons readable with toast shadows.
Owen: agree on stacking. +1 for a token bump. small implementation note: use `align-items: stretch` for stacked actions so full-width buttons align with modal content. snippet:
````css
.modal .actions { display:flex; gap:var(--surface-gap-compact); }
@media (max-width:520px){ .modal .actions{ flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch } }
````
Leah: accessibility catch: when toast appears, it should not grab focus by default. We need an a11y rule: toasts are aria-live polite and focusable only when user interacts. Also contrast: the toast CTA is currently 3.4:1 vs bg. design-bot, can you run contrast and focus-order checks?
design-bot: Contrast report: toast CTA = 3.4:1 (fails AA for 14px). Recommend swap to `text-on-surface-high` or increase weight to 600. Focus-order check: current behavior retains modal focus; ensure toast has tabindex=-1 unless explicitly focused. Full notes: https://internal-reports/design/contrast/1742000123
Ravi: OK let's formalize: 1) token change `surface-gap-sm` -> new alias `surface-gap-compact` = 12px (legacy alias kept for one release), 2) responsive stack at <520px, 3) toasts aria-live polite + tabindex=-1 by default, CTA contrast to be fixed. I'll update the ticket and attach a small storybook scenario for keyboard nav with toasts.
Marta: I'll file the token PR and update the design tokens doc. Owen can you add the Storybook interaction test?
Owen: Yup, will add keyboard/tab tests and visual snapshot for stacked actions.
Leah: I'll add the a11y checklist item and run a small keyboard pass on the prototype.
Ravi: Thanks all — will ping when figma + PRs are ready.
